data.name: Dandelion Void
data.detailed_description:
• Survive on a ruined generation ship full of peril, from starvation to shipquakes to highly-evolved botanical horrors

  • Craft, scavenge, and repurpose tools, clothing, weapons and the finest tech that 1970s Earth had to offer

  • Construct shelters and bases in the abandoned chambers of the Pergola; decorate with looted furniture, or craft your own

  • Customize your character’s lineage, backstory, traits and appearance

  • Face new challenges on each run as the hand-authored ship map is modified with randomized overgrowth and decay

  • Work together to survive alongside friends in optional co-op multiplayer

  • Make the game yours with full mod support at launch

A civilization in a bottle, the starship Pergola carried everything its crew would need for a generations-long voyage: living quarters, hospitals, bars, libraries, reactors, farms, factories, and so much more, now all gone to seed.

Pick your way through ruined halls and corridors in your hunt for resources. Craft and scavenge what you need to survive. Make use of all technology at your disposal, restoring power to doors using computer terminals or fashioning weapons from metal shards and plant stems. Defend yourself against the ship’s horrors new and old: hazardous materials, collapsing structures, broken airlocks, and the over-evolved descendants of its original plant life.

With each attempt, the details of the ship change. The undergrowth spreads differently, doors break or open, medkits are spoiled or water pipes cease to function. Even as your knowledge of the Pergola grows, each run presents a new set of challenges.

There’s more to life than just staying alive. In addition to hunger, thirst, and shelter needs, you must balance your comfort and happiness. Build a home wherever you can: an abandoned air duct, an office supply closet, or a leafy hovel by a reactor cooling pool. Furnish your dwelling with cozy furniture and decorate it with strange artifacts to boost your morale.

In the late 20th century, the brutality of capitalism reached its zenith. Amidst popular uprisings and military expansions, a cadre of artists, scientists, and controversial financiers in the autonomous San Francisco Bay founded the Acorn Starship Collective. Visionaries to some, gutless cowards to others, the ASC launched the Pergola towards an exoplanet with speculated life-sustaining capability, a dozen generations away.

You know nothing of this. Your eyes have never seen these long dead founders, and your feet have never known the soil of Earth. Your world is one of cold steel bulkheads, winding jungle corridors, and the groan of unfamiliar machinery. You are alone. What happened to this place?

Explore and survive with friends in co-op-focused PvPvE multiplayer, either peer-to-peer or with player-hosted servers. Band together to tackle dangerous expeditions, spread the load of base management, or interfere with your friends’ attempts at survival. Even playing solo, you’re bound to encounter unlikely interspecies allies amongst the Pergola’s jungles…

Our game director originates from the modding community of Project Zomboid, which has inspired us to center customization and player agency in this new title. The full game includes Dandelion Void’s custom map editor and its robust Lua API.

Create and modify maps, import custom clothing and weapons, or dream up whole new Lua-scripted scenarios and biomes. Dandelion Void is a game made by modders, for modders.

data.short_description: Survive the jungle-choked halls of a derelict arkship adrift between the stars. Establish a refuge and forage resources from the skeletal remains of your ancestors. Explore solo or with your friends. Fashion what weapons you can, for the jungle is alive and hostile…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 3GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 2GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These specs are tentative while Dandelion Void is in development. Minimum specs are subject to change before Dandelion Void enters Early Access.
